edges.reason: _transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when contract balance exceeds the swap threshold and swap conditions hold.
_transfer forwards accumulated contract ETH to sendETHToFee after the swap.
_transfer delegates final balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer performs inline unchecked addition balanceOf(to)+amount before comparing to _maxWalletSize.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp directly as the swap deadline.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to two external payable addresses.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transfer routes to _transfer using msg.sender as source.
transferFrom routes to _transfer using the caller-supplied sender.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the balance update.
_transferStandard allocates the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reduces reflection supply via _reflectFee.
_getValues derives token values through _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values through _getRValues.
setFee lets the owner arbitrarily rewrite buy/sell fee parameters.
setMaxTxnAmount lets the owner arbitrarily rewrite the transaction limit.
setMaxWalletSize lets the owner arbitrarily rewrite the wallet limit.
The uniswapV2Router state variable supplies the target of the external swap call.
_developmentAddress receives half of the pushed ETH.
_marketingAddress receives half of the pushed ETH.
inSwap lock flag guards the swapTokensForEth external interaction against reentrancy.
The router swap moves tokens through the pair, which can call back into the token's transfer path while _transfer is executing.
_transfer reads _owner to bypass limit, blacklist and trading checks.
renounceOwnership clears _owner.
transferOwnership reassigns _owner after the onlyOwner check.
setTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setFee is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
_transferStandard performs subtraction and addition on _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to the contract's _rOwned entry.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates token fees into _tFeeTotal.
transferFrom reads and reduces the sender allowance.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer selects buy or sell fee values from the fee configuration.
_getTValues computes fees from the current redis and tax fee values.
_transfer rejects blacklisted sender or recipient from the bots mapping.
blockBots writes blacklist entries.
unblockBot clears a blacklist entry.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_transfer checks tradingOpen before allowing non-owner transfers.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before auto-swapping collected fees.
_transfer compares and clamps the amount using _maxTxAmount.
_transfer compares the recipient balance plus amount against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer uses _swapTokensAtAmount as the auto-swap threshold.
msg.sender becomes the from address in _transfer.
transfer uses msg.sender as the token source.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance decrement.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorizes the caller against developer and marketing addresses.
manualsend authorizes the caller against developer and marketing addresses.
setTrading compares msg.sender with _owner through onlyOwner.
blockBots is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner on msg.sender.
unblockBot is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner on msg.sender.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is owner-gated on msg.sender.
